# Introduction

**vue-codemirror6** is a component for using [CodeMirror 6](https://codemirror.net/6/) in Vue. It is built on [vue-demi](https://github.com/vueuse/vue-demi), so the same component works in both Vue 2.7 and Vue 3.

CodeMirror 6 is a modular code editor. Instead of exposing every CodeMirror concept directly, this component turns the most common settings into props and keeps the rest available through `extensions` and the editor instance.

## Features

- **`v-model` binding** for the document text.
- **Common settings as props**: `basic` / `minimal` setup, line wrapping, tab indentation, read-only and disabled modes, placeholder, dark mode, and more.
- **Language, linter, and theme props** that accept any CodeMirror package.
- **Events** for `ready`, `focus`, `update`, `change`, and `destroy`.
- **Instance API** to access the [`EditorView`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView), selection, cursor, lint diagnostics, and CodeMirror 5 style helpers.
- **SSR compatibility**: the editor is only created on the client.
- **Web Component build** of the same component (experimental).

## Supported environments

| Environment | Version                     |
| ----------- | --------------------------- |
| Vue         | `^2.7.14` or `^3.3.4`       |
| CodeMirror  | `codemirror` `^6.0.0`       |
| Output      | ESM (default) and UMD build |

The `@codemirror/*` packages (`state`, `view`, `language`, `lint`, `commands`, `autocomplete`, `search`) are peer dependencies. They are installed together with the `codemirror` package.

## Next steps

- [Getting Started](/vue-codemirror6/guide/getting-started.md) — install the package and render your first editor.
- [Playground](/vue-codemirror6/playground.md) — try the live demo.
- [Props](/vue-codemirror6/api/props.md) — the full list of options.

# Getting Started

## Installation

Install the component together with `codemirror`:

```sh
pnpm add vue-codemirror6 codemirror
```

Language support, linters, and themes are separate packages. Install the ones you need, for example:

```sh
pnpm add @codemirror/lang-javascript
```

## Minimal example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('Cozy lummox gives smart squid who asks for job pen.');
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" />
</template>
```

This renders a plain editor without line numbers or key bindings. Add the `basic` prop to enable CodeMirror's [`basicSetup`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#codemirror.basicSetup) (line numbers, history, bracket matching, search, and more):

```vue
<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic />
</template>
```

:::tip
Use `minimal` instead of `basic` for [`minimalSetup`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#codemirror.minimalSetup). If both are set, `basic` takes precedence.
:::

## Adding a language

Pass a `LanguageSupport` object to the `lang` prop to enable syntax highlighting:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { javascript } from '@codemirror/lang-javascript';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('console.log("Hello, World!");');
const lang = javascript();
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic :lang="lang" />
</template>
```

## Global registration

The package exports an `install` function that registers the component as `CodeMirror`:

```ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { install as CodeMirror } from 'vue-codemirror6';

import App from './App.vue';

createApp(App).use(CodeMirror).mount('#app');
```

After that, `<code-mirror>` can be used in any template without importing it.

## Package exports

| Export                | Description                                                |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `default`             | The Vue component.                                         |
| `install`             | Vue plugin function that registers the component globally. |
| `CodeMirror`          | The component wrapped with `defineCustomElement`.          |
| `CodeMirrorExposed`   | Type of the instance API exposed through a template ref.   |
| `Meta`                | Package version and build date.                            |
| `vue-codemirror6/umd` | UMD build for loading with a `<script>` tag.               |

## Next steps

- [Usage](/vue-codemirror6/guide/usage.md) — `v-model`, slots, read-only mode, and key bindings.
- [Languages, Linters & Themes](/vue-codemirror6/guide/languages-and-themes.md)

# Usage

## Two-way binding with `v-model`

The document is bound through `modelValue` (not `value`), so `v-model` works as with any Vue component.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('');
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic placeholder="Type something…" />
  <pre>{{ value }}</pre>
</template>
```

When `modelValue` is changed from outside, the editor content is replaced. Two props control how the view behaves at that moment:

- `scroll-into-view` (default `true`) scrolls the editor to the updated selection.
- `preserve-scroll-position` (default `false`) keeps the current scroll position, which is useful when text is appended continuously (logs, streaming output, and so on).

## Initial text from a slot

Instead of `v-model`, you can place the initial text inside the component. Only the text of the first child node is used.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { json, jsonParseLinter } from '@codemirror/lang-json';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic readonly :lang="json()" :linter="jsonParseLinter()">
    <pre>
{
  "key": "value"
}</pre>
  </code-mirror>
</template>
```

:::warning

- Slot content overwrites the `v-model` value, so do not combine the two. The slot method is intended for simple read-only highlighting.
- Wrap the text in `<pre>` so that whitespace is not collapsed.
- The slot method does not work with Vue 2.7.

:::

## Read-only and disabled

| Prop       | Editable | Focusable / selectable | CodeMirror option                                                                             |
| ---------- | -------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `readonly` | No       | Yes                    | [`EditorState.readOnly`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorState^readOnly)         |
| `disabled` | No       | No                     | Inverse of [`EditorView.editable`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView^editable) |

Use `disabled` when the editor is only a syntax highlighter.

```vue
<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic :readonly="isReadonly" :disabled="isDisabled" />
</template>
```

## Editing behavior

| Prop                        | Effect                                                      |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `wrap`                      | Enables line wrapping.                                      |
| `tab`                       | Indents with the Tab key instead of moving focus.           |
| `tab-size`                  | Width of a tab character.                                   |
| `indent-unit`               | Indentation unit, for example `"  "` or `"\t"`.             |
| `allow-multiple-selections` | Allows multiple selections (e.g. with Ctrl/Cmd + click).    |
| `line-separator`            | Line separator used for the document. Defaults to `\n`.     |
| `placeholder`               | Text or an `HTMLElement` shown while the document is empty. |

:::tip
The `tab` prop traps the Tab key inside the editor. Keyboard users can still leave the editor by pressing Escape followed by Tab.
:::

## Custom key bindings

Pass an array of [`KeyBinding`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.KeyBinding) objects to `keymap`. If `run` returns `true`, the default behavior for that key is skipped.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { KeyBinding } from '@codemirror/view';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('');

const keymap: KeyBinding[] = [
  {
    key: 'Mod-s',
    run: () => {
      console.log('save', value.value);
      return true;
    }
  }
];
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic :keymap="keymap" />
</template>
```

## Listening to events

```vue
<template>
  <code-mirror
    v-model="value"
    @ready="({ view }) => console.log('ready', view)"
    @focus="focused => (isFocused = focused)"
    @update="update => console.log(update.docChanged)"
  />
</template>
```

See [Events](/vue-codemirror6/api/events.md) for the payload of each event.

## Translating the editor UI

Use `phrases` to translate the text shown by CodeMirror (search panel, lint panel, folding markers, …). See the CodeMirror [translation example](https://codemirror.net/examples/translate/) for the available keys.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const phrases: Record<string, string> = {
  Find: 'Suchen',
  Replace: 'Ersetzen',
  next: 'nächste',
  previous: 'vorherige',
  close: 'schließen'
};
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic :phrases="phrases" />
</template>
```

:::tip
When combining with vue-i18n, make `phrases` reactive (for example a `computed`) so the editor updates when the locale changes. See [Internationalization](/vue-codemirror6/guide/i18n.md) for a full translation table and a vue-i18n example.
:::

# Languages, Linters & Themes

## Languages

Install a language package and pass its `LanguageSupport` object to `lang`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { markdown } from '@codemirror/lang-markdown';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const lang = markdown();
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic wrap :lang="lang" />
</template>
```

Official language packages include:

`@codemirror/lang-angular`, `lang-cpp`, `lang-css`, `lang-html`, `lang-java`, `lang-javascript`, `lang-json`, `lang-lezer`, `lang-markdown`, `lang-php`, `lang-python`, `lang-rust`, `lang-sql`, `lang-vue`, `lang-wast`, `lang-xml`

Many community packages are also available. See the [CodeMirror language list](https://codemirror.net/#languages) and the list below.

## Linters

Pass a [`LintSource`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.LintSource) to `linter`. Add `gutter` to show a marker on lines with problems.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { json, jsonParseLinter } from '@codemirror/lang-json';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('{ "key": "value", }');
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic gutter :lang="json()" :linter="jsonParseLinter()" />
</template>
```

For JavaScript, `@codemirror/lang-javascript` provides `esLint()`, which can be combined with [eslint-linter-browserify](https://github.com/UziTech/eslint-linter-browserify):

```ts
import { esLint } from '@codemirror/lang-javascript';
import eslint from 'eslint-linter-browserify';

const linter = esLint(new eslint.Linter(), {
  languageOptions: {
    parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 2022, sourceType: 'module' }
  },
  rules: { semi: ['error', 'never'] }
});
```

| Prop            | Description                                                                                  |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `linter`        | The lint source.                                                                             |
| `linter-config` | [Linter configuration](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.linter^config) such as `delay`. |
| `force-linting` | Runs the linter immediately instead of waiting for the editor to become idle.                |
| `gutter`        | Shows the lint gutter. Has no effect without `linter`.                                       |
| `gutter-config` | [Lint gutter configuration](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.lintGutter^config).        |

The number of diagnostics is available as `diagnosticCount` on the [instance](/vue-codemirror6/api/instance.md), and `lint()` runs the linter on demand.

:::tip
In the editor, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd> (<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd> on macOS) opens the lint panel and <kbd>F8</kbd> jumps to the next diagnostic.
:::

## Themes and dark mode

- `dark` tells CodeMirror that the editor has a dark background, so built-in UI such as the selection and panels use dark colors.
- `theme` accepts a style spec object passed to [`EditorView.theme`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView^theme).

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const theme = {
  '&': { fontSize: '14px' },
  '.cm-content': { fontFamily: 'Menlo, monospace' },
  '.cm-gutters': { backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none' }
};
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic :dark="isDark" :theme="theme" />
</template>
```

Ready-made themes are usually distributed as extensions. Add them through `extensions`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { oneDark } from '@codemirror/theme-one-dark';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic dark :extensions="[oneDark]" />
</template>
```

Examples: [`@codemirror/theme-one-dark`](https://github.com/codemirror/theme-one-dark), [`@uiw/codemirror-themes`](https://github.com/uiwjs/react-codemirror/tree/master/themes), [`codemirror6-bootstrap-theme`](https://github.com/logue/codemirror6-bootstrap-theme).

## Other extensions

Any CodeMirror [`Extension`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.Extension) can be passed through `extensions`. They are combined with the extensions generated from the other props.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { EditorView } from '@codemirror/view';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const extensions = [EditorView.contentAttributes.of({ spellcheck: 'true' })];
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic :extensions="extensions" />
</template>
```

:::info
`lang` and `linter` could also be passed through `extensions`. They are separate props for type safety and for compatibility with earlier versions.
:::

When props change, the component reconfigures the editor automatically. If you change something the component cannot detect, call `forceReconfigure()` on the instance.

# Internationalization

CodeMirror shows its own UI text: the search and replace panel, folding markers, the lint panel, screen reader announcements, and so on. Pass a translation table to the `phrases` prop to localize it. The keys are the original English strings. For the full list, see the CodeMirror [translation example](https://codemirror.net/examples/translate/).

## Translation table

This example uses vue-codemirror6 as a Markdown editor with the UI translated into Japanese. Keys are grouped by the package that uses them; you only need to include the keys you want to translate.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { markdown } from '@codemirror/lang-markdown';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('');
const lang = markdown();

/**
 * UI translations (Japanese in this example).
 *
 * @see {@link https://codemirror.net/examples/translate/}
 */
const phrases: Record<string, string> = {
  // @codemirror/view
  'Control character': '制御文字',
  // @codemirror/commands
  'Selection deleted': '選択範囲を削除しました',
  // @codemirror/language
  'Folded lines': '折りたたまれた行',
  'Unfolded lines': '展開された行',
  to: '〜',
  'folded code': '折りたたまれたコード',
  unfold: '展開',
  'Fold line': '行を折りたたむ',
  'Unfold line': '行を展開',
  // @codemirror/search
  'Go to line': '行へ移動',
  go: '移動',
  Find: '検索',
  Replace: '置換',
  next: '▼',
  previous: '▲',
  all: 'すべて',
  'match case': '大文字と小文字を区別',
  'by word': '単語単位',
  regexp: '正規表現',
  replace: '置換',
  'replace all': 'すべて置換',
  close: '閉じる',
  'current match': '現在の一致',
  'replaced $ matches': '$ 件を置換しました',
  'replaced match on line $': '$ 行目の一致を置換しました',
  'on line': '行',
  // @codemirror/autocomplete
  Completions: '補完候補',
  // @codemirror/lint
  Diagnostics: '診断',
  'No diagnostics': '問題はありません'
};
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic :lang="lang" :phrases="phrases" />
</template>
```

`$` in a key such as `replaced $ matches` is a placeholder that CodeMirror replaces with a number. Keep it in the translated text.

## Switching languages with vue-i18n

`phrases` is reactive. Changing it reconfigures the editor without recreating it, so you can follow the current vue-i18n locale with a `computed`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const { locale } = useI18n();

/** Translation tables per locale. */
const phrasesByLocale: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {
  ja: {
    Find: '検索',
    Replace: '置換',
    close: '閉じる'
    // ...
  },
  en: {} // Empty: CodeMirror's default (English) text is used.
};

const phrases = computed(() => phrasesByLocale[locale.value]);
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic :phrases="phrases" />
</template>
```

:::tip
Keys missing from the table fall back to CodeMirror’s English text, so a partial table is fine.
:::

# Server-Side Rendering

The component is SSR compatible. CodeMirror is only created in the browser (in `onMounted`), so during server rendering the component outputs its empty container element without touching `window` or `document`.

## Nuxt 3 / Nuxt 4

Use the component directly:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { javascript } from '@codemirror/lang-javascript';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('console.log("Hello, World!");');
const lang = javascript();
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror v-model="value" basic :lang="lang" />
</template>
```

## Nuxt 2 or when problems occur

Wrap the component with `<ClientOnly>` so that it is rendered only in the browser:

```vue
<template>
  <client-only>
    <code-mirror v-model="value" basic :lang="lang" />
  </client-only>
</template>
```

:::info
Because the editor is created after hydration, the instance properties (`view`, `selection`, …) are `undefined` on the server and until the `ready` event is emitted on the client.
:::



---
url: /vue-codemirror6/guide/web-components.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms-full.txt.

# Web Component

:::warning Experimental
The Web Component build is experimental and its behavior may change.
:::

The Web Component build is shipped as a separate entry point, `vue-codemirror6/wc` (Vue 3 only). It wraps the component with Vue's [`defineCustomElement`](https://vuejs.org/guide/extras/web-components.html). Importing it registers `<code-mirror>` automatically:

```ts
import 'vue-codemirror6/wc';
```

```html
<code-mirror></code-mirror>
```

To use an additional tag name, call `register()`. Each extra tag name is registered with a subclass, because a constructor can only be defined once per registry:

```ts
import { register } from 'vue-codemirror6/wc';

register('my-editor');
```

:::warning Type definitions for additional tag names
Only `code-mirror` is added to `HTMLElementTagNameMap`. Tags registered with `register('my-editor')` get no element type, so declare it yourself:

```ts
import type CodeMirrorElement from 'vue-codemirror6/wc';

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    'my-editor': InstanceType<typeof CodeMirrorElement>;
  }
}
```

:::

When using the element inside Vue templates, mark it as a custom element with `compilerOptions.isCustomElement` (e.g. `tag => tag === 'code-mirror'`).

The editor is rendered inside an open shadow root.

## Setting props

- **Primitive props** (`string`, `boolean`, `number`) can be set as attributes or as DOM properties.
- **Object, array, and function props** (`lang`, `linter`, `extensions`, `theme`, `keymap`, …) can only be set as DOM properties.

Set properties before the element is connected to apply them on the first render:

```ts
import { javascript } from '@codemirror/lang-javascript';

const element = document.createElement('code-mirror');
element.setAttribute('readonly', '');
element.modelValue = 'const x = 1;';
element.lang = javascript();

document.body.append(element);
```

## Events

Vue emits are dispatched as native `CustomEvent`s. The emitted arguments are available as an array in `event.detail`.

```ts
element.addEventListener('ready', event => {
  const [{ view }] = (event as CustomEvent).detail;
  console.log(view);
});

element.addEventListener('update:model-value', event => {
  const [value] = (event as CustomEvent).detail;
  console.log(value);
});
```

## Instance API

The [instance API](/vue-codemirror6/api/instance.md) is exposed directly on the element:

```ts
import type { CodeMirrorExposed } from 'vue-codemirror6';

const editor = element as unknown as CodeMirrorExposed;
editor.replaceRange('bye', 0, 5);
console.log(editor.view?.state.doc.toString());
```

url: /vue-codemirror6/guide/bundling.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms-full.txt.

# Bundling Tips

CodeMirror and its language packages are relatively large. Splitting them into their own chunks keeps your main bundle small and lets browsers cache the editor separately.

## Vite

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  build: {
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks: {
          codemirror: ['vue-codemirror6'],
          'codemirror-lang': [
            // Add the languages you use.
            '@codemirror/lang-html',
            '@codemirror/lang-javascript',
            '@codemirror/lang-markdown'
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
});
```

## Rsbuild

```ts
// rsbuild.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from '@rsbuild/core';

export default defineConfig({
  splitChunks: {
    cacheGroups: {
      codemirror: {
        test: /node_modules[\\/](@codemirror|codemirror|@lezer)[\\/]/,
        name: 'codemirror',
        chunks: 'all'
      }
    }
  }
});
```

## Lazy loading

If the editor is not needed on the first screen, load it asynchronously:

```ts
import { defineAsyncComponent } from 'vue';

const CodeMirror = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('vue-codemirror6'));
```

# API Overview

The `CodeMirror` component has three kinds of API:

| Page                                             | Content                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Props](/vue-codemirror6/api/props.md)           | Options that configure the editor. Changes are applied without recreating it. |
| [Events](/vue-codemirror6/api/events.md)         | Notifications for loading, focus, document changes, and destruction.          |
| [Instance API](/vue-codemirror6/api/instance.md) | Properties and methods available through a template ref.                      |

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { javascript } from '@codemirror/lang-javascript';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror, { type CodeMirrorExposed } from 'vue-codemirror6';

const value = ref('');
const cm = ref<CodeMirrorExposed>();
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror
    ref="cm"
    v-model="value"
    basic
    :lang="javascript()"
    @ready="() => cm?.view?.focus()"
  />
</template>
```



---
url: /vue-codemirror6/api/props.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms-full.txt.

# Props

Props are written in kebab-case in templates (`tab-size`) and camelCase in JavaScript (`tabSize`).

## Content

| Prop          | Type                    | Default     | Description                                                                                              |
| ------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model-value` | `string \| Text`        | `''`        | The document. Use with `v-model`. (Not `value`.)                                                         |
| `placeholder` | `string \| HTMLElement` | `undefined` | Shown while the document is empty. See [placeholder](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.placeholder). |
| `tag`         | `string`                | `'div'`     | Tag name of the root element.                                                                            |

## Setup

| Prop      | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                   |
| --------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `basic`   | `boolean` | `false` | Enables [`basicSetup`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#codemirror.basicSetup).                               |
| `minimal` | `boolean` | `false` | Enables [`minimalSetup`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#codemirror.minimalSetup). `basic` takes precedence. |

## Editing

| Prop                        | Type           | Default     | Description                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `readonly`                  | `boolean`      | `false`     | Prevents changes but keeps the editor focusable. See [`readOnly`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorState^readOnly).      |
| `disabled`                  | `boolean`      | `false`     | Makes the editor non-editable and non-focusable. Inverse of [`editable`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView^editable). |
| `wrap`                      | `boolean`      | `false`     | Enables [line wrapping](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView^lineWrapping).                                              |
| `tab`                       | `boolean`      | `false`     | Indents with the Tab key ([`indentWithTab`](https://codemirror.net/examples/tab/)).                                                  |
| `tab-size`                  | `number`       | `undefined` | [Tab size](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorState^tabSize).                                                              |
| `indent-unit`               | `string`       | `undefined` | [Indentation unit](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#language.indentUnit).                                                            |
| `allow-multiple-selections` | `boolean`      | `false`     | [Allows multiple selections](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorState^allowMultipleSelections).                            |
| `line-separator`            | `string`       | `undefined` | [Line separator](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorState^lineSeparator). `\n` when not set.                               |
| `keymap`                    | `KeyBinding[]` | `[]`        | Custom [key bindings](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.KeyBinding).                                                             |

## Language and linting

| Prop            | Type              | Default     | Description                                                                                           |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lang`          | `LanguageSupport` | `undefined` | Language for syntax highlighting. See [languages](https://codemirror.net/#languages).                 |
| `linter`        | `LintSource`      | `undefined` | Lint source, e.g. `jsonParseLinter()` or `esLint(...)`.                                               |
| `linter-config` | `object`          | `{}`        | [Linter config](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.linter^config).                                 |
| `force-linting` | `boolean`         | `false`     | Runs the linter right away. See [`forceLinting`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.forceLinting). |
| `gutter`        | `boolean`         | `false`     | Shows the [lint gutter](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.lintGutter). Requires `linter`.         |
| `gutter-config` | `object`          | `undefined` | [Lint gutter config](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.lintGutter^config).                        |

## Appearance

| Prop      | Type                        | Default     | Description                                                                                        |
| --------- | --------------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dark`    | `boolean`                   | `false`     | Marks the editor theme as dark.                                                                    |
| `theme`   | `Record<string, StyleSpec>` | `{}`        | Style spec passed to [`EditorView.theme`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView^theme). |
| `phrases` | `Record<string, string>`    | `undefined` | [UI translations](https://codemirror.net/examples/translate/).                                     |

## Scrolling

| Prop                       | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scroll-into-view`         | `boolean` | `true`  | Scrolls to the selection when `modelValue` is updated externally. See [`scrollIntoView`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.TransactionSpec.scrollIntoView). |
| `preserve-scroll-position` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the scroll position when `modelValue` is updated externally. See [`scrollSnapshot`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView.scrollSnapshot).      |

## Extensions

| Prop         | Type          | Default | Description                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `extensions` | `Extension[]` | `[]`    | Additional [extensions](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.Extension), appended after the ones generated from props. |



---
url: /vue-codemirror6/api/events.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms-full.txt.

# Events

| Event               | Payload                                                             | Emitted when                                                    |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `update:modelValue` | `string \| Text`                                                    | The document changed. Used by `v-model`.                        |
| `ready`             | `{ view: EditorView; state: EditorState; container: HTMLElement }`  | The editor has been created (after mount, client side only).    |
| `focus`             | `boolean`                                                           | The editor gained (`true`) or lost (`false`) focus.             |
| `update`            | [`ViewUpdate`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.ViewUpdate)    | Any update of the view: document, selection, focus, viewport, … |
| `change`            | [`EditorState`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorState) | The document changed. Receives the new state.                   |
| `destroy`           | —                                                                   | The editor was destroyed (component unmounted).                 |

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { EditorState } from '@codemirror/state';
import type { ViewUpdate } from '@codemirror/view';
import CodeMirror from 'vue-codemirror6';

const onUpdate = (update: ViewUpdate) => {
  if (update.selectionSet) {
    console.log('selection', update.state.selection.main);
  }
};

const onChange = (state: EditorState) => {
  console.log('lines', state.doc.lines);
};
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror basic @update="onUpdate" @change="onChange" />
</template>
```

When the component is used as a [Web Component](/vue-codemirror6/guide/web-components.md), these are dispatched as native `CustomEvent`s and the payload is available as `event.detail[0]`. The model event is named `update:model-value`.



---
url: /vue-codemirror6/api/instance.md
---

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /vue-codemirror6/llms-full.txt.

# Instance API

Access the instance through a template ref. Use the `CodeMirrorExposed` type for type checking.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import CodeMirror, { type CodeMirrorExposed } from 'vue-codemirror6';

const cm = ref<CodeMirrorExposed>();

const insertDate = () => {
  cm.value?.replaceSelection(new Date().toISOString());
};
</script>

<template>
  <code-mirror ref="cm" basic />
  <button type="button" @click="insertDate">Insert date</button>
</template>
```

:::info
The editor is created after mount. Until the `ready` event, `view` and the values derived from it are `undefined` or empty.
:::

## Properties

| Property          | Type                                  | Description                                                                                                             |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `view`            | `EditorView \| undefined`             | The [`EditorView`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#view.EditorView). Use it for anything not wrapped by the component. |
| `editor`          | `HTMLElement \| undefined`            | The root element that contains the editor.                                                                              |
| `dom`             | `Element \| undefined`                | The editable content element.                                                                                           |
| `selection`       | `EditorSelection \| undefined`        | Gets or sets the [selection](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#state.EditorSelection).                                   |
| `cursor`          | `number`                              | Gets or sets the cursor position.                                                                                       |
| `focus`           | `boolean`                             | Gets or sets the focus state.                                                                                           |
| `length`          | `number`                              | Length of the document.                                                                                                 |
| `json`            | `Record<string, StateField<unknown>>` | Gets or sets the state as a JSON-serializable object.                                                                   |
| `diagnosticCount` | `number`                              | Number of lint diagnostics. See [`diagnosticCount`](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#lint.diagnosticCount).             |

## Methods

| Method               | Description                                                            |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lint()`             | Runs the linter immediately. Only works when the `linter` prop is set. |
| `forceReconfigure()` | Removes and re-registers all extensions.                               |

## CodeMirror 5 compatible methods

These methods are provided for users familiar with [CodeMirror 5](https://codemirror.net/5/). The properties above and `view` are usually sufficient, so **active use is not recommended**.

| Method                                                               | Description                                   |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `getRange(from?: number, to?: number)`                               | Gets the text between the given positions.    |
| `getLine(number: number)`                                            | Gets the content of a line.                   |
| `lineCount()`                                                        | Gets the number of lines.                     |
| `getCursor()`                                                        | Gets one end of the primary selection.        |
| `listSelections()`                                                   | Gets all current selection ranges.            |
| `getSelection()`                                                     | Gets the selected text.                       |
| `getSelections()`                                                    | Gets the text of every selection range.       |
| `somethingSelected()`                                                | Returns `true` if any text is selected.       |
| `replaceRange(replacement: string \| Text, from, to)`                | Replaces the text between `from` and `to`.    |
| `replaceSelection(replacement: string \| Text)`                      | Replaces the selection(s).                    |
| `setCursor(position: number)`                                        | Sets the cursor position.                     |
| `setSelection(anchor: number, head?: number)`                        | Sets a single selection range.                |
| `setSelections(ranges: readonly SelectionRange[], primary?: number)` | Sets multiple selection ranges.               |
| `extendSelectionsBy(f: (range: SelectionRange) => number)`           | Extends every selection by the result of `f`. |

# vue-codemirror6

CodeMirror 6 for Vue

> A lightweight wrapper component that brings the CodeMirror 6 editor to Vue 2.7 and Vue 3.

[Get Started](/guide/getting-started) | [Playground](/playground) | [GitHub](https://github.com/logue/vue-codemirror6)

## Features

- [💚 **Vue 2.7 & Vue 3**](/guide/introduction): Built on vue-demi, so the same component works in both Vue 2.7 and Vue 3 projects.
- [🔁 **Two-way binding**](/guide/usage): Bind the document with v-model just like a native input. External updates can keep the scroll position.
- [🎨 **Languages, linters, and themes**](/guide/languages-and-themes): Pass any CodeMirror LanguageSupport, LintSource, or theme through props, or add raw extensions.
- [🌐 **SSR ready**](/guide/ssr): CodeMirror is only initialized on the client, so the component renders safely in Nuxt and other SSR frameworks.
- [🧩 **Web Component**](/guide/web-components): The same component is also exported as a custom element for use outside Vue (experimental).
- [🛠️ **Full editor API**](/api/instance): Access the EditorView, selection, and CodeMirror 5 style helper methods through a template ref.
